newsitem.title: USA: Intl Rectifier to restructure, take charge.
newsitem.headline: Intl Rectifier to restructure, take charge.

text.p: International Rectifier Corp Monday said it would restructure its operations and take a related fourth quarter charge of $1.50 per share.
It said the restructuring was designed to improve its competitive position and "accelerate strong, sustainable earnings growth into the next century."

The restucturing, which will involve reducing payroll by more than five percent, is expected to produce annual pretax savings of about $15 million in fiscal 1998 and about $20 million in annual savings thereafter.

Other parts of the restructuring are the transfer of manufacturing operations into more advanced facilities, moving research and development activity into a new facility, consolidating administrative and service functions and revaluing assets, including older production facilities and information systems.
International Rectifier makes power semiconductors, which convert electrical energy to operate power supplies, motor drives and lighting ballasts.
